order_issue.description: order_issue (e.g. "received the wrong product", "recommend another product", "cancel my order", "i want a refund")

unknown.description: unknown (if confidence is low or it does not match the above)

replace_product.description: replace_product (if the user wants to replace or exchange a damaged/incorrect product)

cancel_product.description: cancel_product (if the user wants to cancel a product or cancel an order)

product_recommendation.description: product_recommendation (if the user asks for suggestions or product recommendations)

refund.description: refund (if the user explicitly asks for a refund or money back, including for wrong orders)
